novelty.justification: The core novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: the claim predicts that adopting a false-believing persona “shifts the model's OWN internal factual belief,” that this shift predicts “own-voice factual leakage,” and that a “belief-ownership” direction can insulate it. Searches using “LLM persona false belief contamination,” “role-play own belief representation leakage,” “self other belief activation steering,” and “persona drift factual beliefs” identified Language Models Represent Beliefs of Self and Others (2024), Brittle Minds, Fixable Activations (2024), and The Assistant Axis (2026) as the closest work, but these respectively study agent-indexed story beliefs, editable ToM representations, and generic persona drift rather than persona-induced corruption of a separately decoded own factual belief. Moving from those works to the contamination-to-leakage relationship requires a new core hypothesis rather than merely changing the dataset, although simultaneous linear decoding and contrastive activation steering are standard techniques, so this is a high-novelty contribution within existing belief-representation and persona frameworks rather than a new paradigm.
